payload.text: Rules in force: every test run on this Mac or kovacs, however small (one bats file, one prez AT), is booked as a window with intent-vc by name through utilz-vc first, and ENDed by name; reading logs needs no window. CI shellcheck is ubuntu-latest apt 0.9.0, which flags A && B || C as SC2015 where 0.11.0 passes: run it under 0.9.0 on kovacs before handing on. A portable stat puts the GNU form first (stat -c), since GNU stat -f reports the filesystem rather than failing (relink.bats AT17, fd2a621). No Hammerspoon, pointer, xcodebuild or hv real keychain from dc; nothing pushed by dc.
